messages:
lex: small coordination thread 1 min 'windowed drop' idea for spot-awards next Tue. goal: super low-key desk drop + 1-line card. who can take routes + packs?
omar: I can run the mid-floor route 11:30-12:15. need recipient desk list by Mon noon.
rachel: happy to assemble packs (card + sticker + tiny treat). doing pre-filled boxes reduces errors. will need pack counts by Mon EOD.
payroll-bot: Reminder: submit spot-award amounts to payroll portal by Wed 9am PT to ensure proper tax reporting. Awards over $100 are taxable.
lex: budget: up to $150 for snacks/treats. rachel pls keep receipts.
toni: I'll handle remote shipping and tracking. please add 'ship/pickup' column in the sheet and fill addresses.
oram: small script idea: 1) quick hello + reason, 2) drop item, 3) smile and move on. keep to 60s max.
rachel: packing checklist for assembly team:
``
- verify name + desk
- include one-line reason card
- pack sticker + tiny treat
- add 'no-photo' flag if requested
- label envelope with recipient name
```
toni: shipping plan: domestic via USPS, small intl via partner courier. will post courier matrix after addresses in.
lex: volunteers: omar route lead, rachel packs, toni shipping, lex messaging + final recipient DM.
payroll-bot: FYI: include employee IDs in payroll export to avoid mismatches.
lex: sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WindowedDrop-Kits (fill cols F:G for pickup & photo consent).
oram: can someone bring a small 'quiet congrats' sign? keeps vibe low-key.
rachel: packing window Mon afternoon, ship Tue AM. will post final pack counts here.
toni: i'll add tracking into sheet as packs go out.
lex: final actions: 1) lex finalize recipients Mon 10am, 2) rachel assemble Mon afternoon, 3) toni prepare labels Tue AM, 4) omar run route Tue 11:30.
omar: confirmed. will DM any folks who are remote to arrange pickup.
lex: thanks team 49A keep it small & sincere.
